items.text: "Zibasanze abasumba abazikiriza era abasaasaanya endiga z'ekisibo kyange!" bw'ayogera

, Katonda wa Isirayiri ebikwata ku basumba abalabirira abantu bange nti, "Kubanga musaasaanyizza abantu bange ne mubagoba ne mutabalabirira, nzija kubaleetako ebibonerezo olw'ebibi bye mukoze," bw'ayogera
"Nze kennyini nzija kukuŋŋaanya abaasigalawo ku kisibo kyange okuva mu mawanga gonna gye nabagobera, mbakomyewo mu kisibo kyabwe, gye banaabalira ebibala beeyongere obungi.
Ndibawa abasumba abanaabalabirira, era tebaliddayo kutya oba kuggwaamu maanyi, era tewaabe n'omu abula," bw'ayogera
akole ebituufu eby'obwenkanya mu nsi," bwayogera
"Noolwekyo ennaku zijja, abantu lwe batalyogera nate nti, 'Ddala nga
bwali omulamu eyaggya Abayisirayiri mu Misiri,' bwayogera
bw'ali omulamu, eyaggya abaana ba Isirayiri mu nsi ey'omu bukiikakkono era ne mu nsi zonna gye yali abagobedde.' Olwo balibeera mu nsi yaabwe ku bwabwe," bw'ayogera
omutima gwange gwennyise mu nda yange
era bakozesa obuyinza bwabwe mu butali bwenkanya.
ne mu yeekaalu yange mbasanze nga bakoleramu ebibi,"
Era ne mu bannabbi ba Yerusaalemi
Bakola eby'obwenzi ne batambulira mu bulimba.
ne wataba n'omu ava mu kwonoona kwe.
Bonna bali nga Sodomu gye ndi;
abantu ba Yerusaalemi bali nga Ggomola."
Katonda ow'Eggye ebikwata ku bannabbi nti,
kubanga okuva mu bannabbi ba Yerusaalemi,
obutatya Katonda bubunye mu nsi yonna."
Boogera ebirooto ebiva mu mitima gyabwe,
so si ebiva mu kamwa ka
Mu nnaku ezijja, mujja kukitegeera bulungi.
Naye singa bayimirira mu maaso gange,
era bandibaggye mu makubo gaabwe amabi
era ne mu bikolwa byabwe ebibi.
"Mpulidde bannabbi aboogera eby'obulimba mu linnya lyange. Bagamba nti, 'Naloose! Naloose!'
Kino kinaakoma ddi mu mitima gy'abo bannabbi b'obulimba, abategeeza eby'obulimba ebiva ku mitima gyabwe?
Balowooza nti ebirooto bye balootolola bannaabwe bijja kuleetera abantu bange okwerabira erinnya lyange, nga bakitaabwe bwe beerabira erinnya lyange nga basinza Baali.
Nnabbi alina ekirooto ayogere ekirooto kye, n'oyo alina ekigambo kyange akyogere mu bwesigwa. Kubanga ebisusunku birina nkolagana ki n'eŋŋaano?" bw'ayogera
"Ekigambo kyange tekiri nga muliro, ng'ennyondo eyasaayasa olwazi?" bw'ayogera
"Noolwekyo, ndi mulabe wa bannabbi ababbiŋŋanako ebigambo ebiva gye ndi," bw'ayogera
, "saagalira ddala bannabbi abayogerayogera nga bagamba nti, 'Bw'atyo

Ddala ddala ndi mulabe w'abo abawa obunnabbi bw'ebirooto ebikyamu. Babyogera ne babuza abantu bange n'obulimba bwabwe obutaliimu, ate nga saabatuma wadde okubateekawo. Tebalina kye bayamba bantu bano n'akatono," bw'ayogera
"Abantu bano, oba nnabbi oba kabona bw'abuuza nti, 'Bubaka ki
bw'atutumye?' Bagambe nti, 'Bubaka ki? Nzija kubabuulira, bw'ayogera
Nnabbi, oba kabona oba omuntu yenna bw'agamba nti, 'Buno bwe bubaka bwa
,' Nzija kubonereza omusajja oyo n'ab'omu maka ge.
Kino buli omu ky'anagamba mikwano gye oba ab'eŋŋanda ze. '
Naye temuddayo kugamba nti, 'Buno bwe bubaka bwa
,' kubanga buli kigambo kya muntu kifuuka bubaka bwe era mukyusa ebigambo bya Katonda omulamu,
Naye era mujja kugamba nti, 'Buno bwe bubaka
bwatutumye,' wadde nga nabagamba nti, Temusaanye kwogera nti, 'Buno bwe bubaka bwa
kyenaava mbagobera ddala mu maaso gange ne mu kibuga ekyo kye nabawa, mmwe ne bakitammwe.
Ndibaleetako ekivume ekitaliggwaawo, n'ensonyi ez'olubeerera ebitagenda kwerabirwa."
